title: Scalar Hom map after module raw pullback expansion
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring in Type(u+1), W,S schemes in universe u, k:W→S, G an etale Λ-module sheaf on W, q a natural number, U∈S.Etale, A,B∈Over(W), f:A→B and z a raw module class at B. The scalar Hom map at A evaluated on the module raw pullback of z equals scalarSourceFactor at A.hom≫k followed by derived scalar forgetting of moduleSourceFactor, derived scalar forgetting of the derived module inverse image of z, and derived scalar forgetting of moduleCoefficientFactor, followed by scalarCoefficientFactor at A.hom. No source coherence, inverse derived scalar comparison, abelian source factor or abelian raw pullback is used. Interpret the raw class values occurring in this equation at their native derived Hom types using the concrete identity views [def-sbc-raw-class-native-morphisms]; the elements and equality are unchanged. Write the module coefficient morphism at its named raw-complex endpoints using the definitionally equal canonical view [def-sbc-module-coefficient-native-endpoints].

proof.text: Apply the existing rawModuleScalarHom_evaluate equation at the module raw pullback class. Both raw output and class input are explicitly read as derived morphisms by the concrete identity functions, so the equation is exactly scalarSourceFactor followed by derived forgetting of the class and scalarCoefficientFactor.

Use the module component of the existing rawModuleScalar_pullback_formulas theorem as the raw input equation for the private generic map_three_factors lemma. Functor.map_comp distributes derived scalar forgetting across the source, class and coefficient factors. Combine this with the scalar Hom evaluation equation from step 1. Proof irrelevance identifies the two witnesses for the Over triangle. No scalar source coherence or coefficient square identity is used.

lean.statement:
theorem rawModuleScalar_hom_composite_formula
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale)
    (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op B)) :
    rawAbelianClassMorphism (A.hom ≫ k)
      (restrictedOverCoefficient ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G) A) q U
      (rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A
        ((higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).map f.op z)) =
      scalarSourceFactor Λ (A.hom ≫ k) ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U)
        (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeAbelian S U)
        (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeMap Λ S U) ≫
      (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (moduleSourceFactor Λ f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
          (by rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w]) ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U)) ≫
      (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          (rawModuleClassMorphism Λ k G (q : ℤ) U B z)) ≫
      (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (moduleCoefficientFactorNative Λ G (q : ℤ) A B f) ≫
      scalarCoefficientFactor Λ A.hom G (q : ℤ)
